label: Either some bearer of an occurring thought has a concrete ground-ancestor…, by… (2)
meaning: Thinker-local fork (#564, refining #553 and BRUTE-ROOT-DISJUNCTION). Take an occurring thought and its bearer from COGITO-SUBJECT-FROM-OCCURRENCE (thinkingSubjectOfThought); the bearer is concrete and exists at w by the #536 bridges. Descend along actual concrete grounds by Acc induction from the bearer. At each ground-ancestor, excluded middle decides whether it has an actual concrete ground (descend), else whether it is contingent at w (second horn: a contingent root of the relation in the thinker's ancestry), else it exists at every accessible world (first horn). Neither the bearer's contingency nor any dependence principle is used; whole-carrier well-foundedness is replaced by Acc at the bearer. All five non-logical premises are open; STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE (self-evident-marked) is an explicit hypothesis, not a Lean axiom. Neither horn is asserted; the second horn's root may have a non-concrete explanation. No substance, uniqueness, simplicity, intellect or God follows.
